title: (RHBA-2023:1354) Red Hat OpenShift Data Foundation 4.9.14 bug fix update
portal_summary: Updated images that fix several bugs are now available for Red Hat OpenShift Data Foundation 4.9.14 on Red Hat Enterprise Linux 8 from Red Hat Container Registry.
portal_synopsis: Red Hat OpenShift Data Foundation 4.9.14 bug fix update
portal_product_filter: Red Hat OpenShift Data Foundation|Red Hat OpenShift Data Foundation|4|x86_64
Red Hat OpenShift Data Foundation|Red Hat OpenShift Data Foundation for IBM Z and LinuxONE|4|s390x
Red Hat OpenShift Data Foundation|Red Hat OpenShift Data Foundation for IBM Power, little endian|4|ppc64le
portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata
relevant to your system have been applied.

For details on how to apply this update, refer to:

https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258
portal_description:
Red Hat OpenShift Data Foundation is software-defined storage integrated with and optimized for the Red Hat OpenShift Data Foundation. Red Hat OpenShift Data Foundation is a highly scalable, production-grade persistent storage for stateful applications running in the Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform. In addition to persistent storage, Red Hat OpenShift Data Foundation provisions a multicloud data management service with an S3 compatible API.

Bug fix(es):

Previously, listing operation would fail depending on the number of objects in the bucket due to incorrect mapping of indexes in the Multicloud Object Gateway data base (MCG DB). This incorrect mapping caused certain queries to take longer time than needed and as a result, some specific actions were failing. With this fix, the indexes are updated to fix the listing queries.
